changelog: - **Documents and files stay inside their org** (#2542). Document, CvFile, AvatarFile, MessageAttachment and SupportAttachment carry no `orgId`, so the tenant middleware never scoped them, and an admin of one org could list, download and delete another org's documents, templates, CVs, avatars and message / support attachments, or upload to its users, whether `MT_ENFORCE_ISOLATION` was on or off. Each route now resolves the row's parent org (owner, template uploader, thread relation, conversation participants, ticket requester; `src/lib/ownerOrg.ts`) and answers **404** when it is not the caller's (`inCallerTenant`, the one-row form of `tenantWhere()`), before any write. `canAccessUserDocs` / `canAccessCv` limit the admin branch to the owner's org too, and `POST /api/cv`, `/api/cv/[userId]/suggest` and `/extract-ai` answer 404 for another org's user before that check. The requirement routes (`/api/admin/document-requirements`, `[id]`, `/api/admin/documents/missing`) took the org from the request, and PATCH/DELETE compared the row's org only with an org the caller supplied. They now go through `mayManageOrgRequirements()`, which allows the caller's own org (an org-less caller is the default org's) or a super admin, checks against the stored row's org, and answers 404 otherwise. A signed-in viewer from another org still sees a public-profile avatar. Behaviour inside one tenant is unchanged; an org-less side on either end counts as the default org, never as a wildcard. Pinned in `e2e/cross-tenant-documents.spec.ts`.
